about:
Snider Custom Apparel operates as a custom decoration shop in Gilbert, Arizona. The company provides screen printing, direct-to-garment (DTG) printing, and embroidery services for apparel and promotional items.

The shop applies logos, names, and numbers to a range of garments including shirts, jackets, caps, bags, banners, jerseys, and uniforms. It also decorates accessories such as aprons, blankets, and towels, and supplies promotional products including pens, mugs, water bottles, patches, golf accessories, and USB flash drives. Customers may provide their own artwork or have the shop create a design, and orders can be placed through an online catalog or custom online stores.

The business serves schools, sports teams, and corporate clients, delivering decorated uniforms for players, spirit wear for students, and branded merchandise for companies.

Snider Custom Apparel emphasizes design flexibility and online ordering convenience, offering both artwork creation assistance and a promotional product catalog with free quotes.
